<string name="settings_help_notifications">Quick Add is an optional persistent notification for one-tap point saves. It only saves when a recent accurate cache entry is available or a fresh precise fix can be obtained; otherwise it reports failure without creating a point. While enabled, the app may opportunistically warm a short-lived Quick Add cache from system location updates without continuous tracking. On Android 13+, enabling the notification needs notification permission. To keep that strict cache warm after the app goes to background, Quick Add also needs precise location and, on Android 10+, background location ("Allow all the time").</string>

<string name="settings_quick_add_notification_desc">Shows an optional persistent notification for strict Quick Add saves using a recent accurate cache or one fresh precise fix. Background cache warming also needs precise location and, on Android 10+, background location.</string>
